```artifact
Feature: Admin Management

  Scenario: Add Lab
    Given the admin is logged in
    When the admin adds a new lab with name "Cardiology Lab" and address "123 Main St"
    Then the lab is added successfully
    And the lab is listed in the admin dashboard

  Scenario: Add Chemist
    Given the admin is logged in
    When the admin adds a new chemist with name "John Doe" and email "john.doe@example.com"
    Then the chemist is added successfully
    And the chemist is listed in the admin dashboard

  Scenario: Update Doctor
    Given the admin is logged in
    And the doctor "Dr. Smith" is associated with the speciality "Cardiology"
    When the admin updates the doctor's name to "Dr. Jane Doe"
    Then the doctor's name is updated successfully
    And the doctor's name is displayed as "Dr. Jane Doe" in the admin dashboard

  Scenario: Add Speciality
    Given the admin is logged in
    When the admin adds a new speciality with name "Neurology"
    Then the speciality is added successfully
    And the speciality is listed in the admin dashboard

  Scenario: View and Update Speciality
    Given the admin is logged in
    And the speciality "Cardiology" exists
    When the admin views the speciality details
    Then the speciality details are displayed correctly
    When the admin updates the speciality name to "Cardiovascular"
    Then the speciality name is updated successfully
    And the speciality name is displayed as "Cardiovascular" in the admin dashboard

  Scenario: Delete Speciality
    Given the admin is logged in
    And the speciality "Cardiology" exists
    When the admin deletes the speciality
    Then the speciality is deleted successfully
    And the speciality is no longer listed in the admin dashboard

  Scenario: Add Doctor to Speciality
    Given the admin is logged in
    And the speciality "Cardiology" exists
    When the admin adds a new doctor to the speciality
    Then the doctor is added successfully
    And the doctor is listed in the speciality's doctor list

  Scenario Outline: Add Doctor with Duplicate Speciality
    Given the admin is logged in
    When the admin adds a new doctor with speciality "Cardiology"
    Then the doctor is added successfully
    Examples:
      | speciality |
      | Cardiology | Cardiology |

  Scenario Outline: Delete Speciality with Attached Doctors
    Given the admin is logged in
    And the speciality "Cardiology" exists
    And the speciality has attached doctors
    When the admin deletes the speciality
    Then the speciality is not deleted due to attached doctors
    Examples:
      | speciality | attached_doctors |
      | Cardiology | true             |

  Scenario Outline: Update Doctor with Invalid Data
    Given the admin is logged in
    And the doctor "Dr. Smith" is associated with the speciality "Cardiology"
    When the admin updates the doctor's name to "Invalid Name"
    Then the doctor's name is not updated due to invalid data
    Examples:
      | name |
      | Invalid Name |

  Scenario Outline: Add Speciality with Duplicate Name
    Given the admin is logged in
    When the admin adds a new speciality with name "Cardiology"
    Then the speciality is not added due to duplicate name
    Examples:
      | name |
      | Cardiology |

  Scenario Outline: Add Doctor with Maximum Number of Doctors
    Given the admin is logged in
    And the speciality "Cardiology" exists
    And the speciality has maximum number of doctors
    When the admin adds a new doctor to the speciality
    Then the doctor is not added due to maximum number of doctors
    Examples:
      | max_doctors |
      | 10          |
```
